is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. melas) in Gabon.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotypes for Vgsc L995F/S (kdr-w/kdr-e) and Ace-1 G280S (ace1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts for kdr (S/S, S/Rw, S/Re, Rw/Rw, Re/Re, Rw/Re) and AChE (S/S, S/R, RR) for An. gambiae s.s. in Libreville and Port-Gentil.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Libreville and Port-Gentil, Gabon.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original entomological study conducted by the authors.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies locations as 'camp de Gaulle' in Libreville and 'camp N’tchorere' in Port-Gentil, including coordinates.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from December 2006 to April 2007.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific entomological survey conducted by the authors in 2006-2007.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts, are provided in Table 2.

assessment.summary: This study reports on malaria transmission and insecticide resistance markers (kdr and ace1) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles melas collected from two French military camps in Libreville and Port-Gentil, Gabon, between 2006 and 2007.
